output.why: The specification documents already conflict on the operating configuration of the SG Unit-2 floor wash water transfer pumps: Section IA Clause 7.1.13 (Part1.pdf p.43) specifies Two (2) nos. (1W+1S), whereas the ETP P&ID (Part3.pdf p.146) and Datasheet A (Part4.pdf p.58) specify Two (2W) nos. rated at 105 m3/hr each. Changing 2W to 1W+1S without resizing the pumps would halve the total pumping capacity from 210 m3/hr to 105 m3/hr.
